<iframe class="stIFrame st-emotion-cache-fsrfgf evfee5y0" data-testid="stIFrame" allow="accelerometer; ambient-light-sensor; autoplay; battery; camera; clipboard-write; document-domain; encrypted-media; fullscreen; geolocation; gyroscope; layout-animations; legacy-image-formats; magnetometer; microphone; midi; oversized-images; payment; picture-in-picture; publickey-credentials-get; sync-xhr; usb; vr ; wake-lock; xr-spatial-tracking" srcdoc="
    <div style="display:none;">
    <script>
    (function() {
        const parentDoc = window.parent.document;
        const NAV_LABELS = ["Search", "Catalog", "Glossary", "Discovery", "Health", "Admin"];
        const TAB_MAP = {"search": "Search", "catalog": "Catalog", "glossary": "Glossary", "discovery": "Discovery", "health": "Health", "admin": "Admin"};
        const iframeId = Math.random().toString(36);

        function wire() {
            const allBtns = Array.from(parentDoc.querySelectorAll('button'));
            
            // 1. Hide proxy buttons
            allBtns.forEach(btn => {
                const label = btn.textContent.trim();
                if (NAV_LABELS.includes(label) || label === 'LOCALE_EN' || label === 'LOCALE_FR') {
                    const wrapper = btn.closest('div[data-testid="stButton"]');
                    if (wrapper) wrapper.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });

            // 2. Wire Navigation
            parentDoc.querySelectorAll('a.dd-nav-tab[data-tab], a.dd-logo-link[data-tab]').forEach(link => {
                if (link._wired === iframeId) return;
                link._wired = iframeId;
                link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const tabId = this.getAttribute('data-tab');
                    const localizedLabel = TAB_MAP[tabId];
                    const currentBtns = Array.from(parentDoc.querySelectorAll('button'));
                    const btn = currentBtns.find(b => b.textContent.trim() === localizedLabel);
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                });
            });

            // 3. Wire Language
            parentDoc.querySelectorAll('a.dd-lang-opt[data-lang]').forEach(link => {
                if (link._wired === iframeId) return;
                link._wired = iframeId;
                link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const lang = this.getAttribute('data-lang').toUpperCase();
                    const currentBtns = Array.from(parentDoc.querySelectorAll('button'));
                    const btn = currentBtns.find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'LOCALE_' + lang);
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                });
            });
        }

        // Initial wire
        setTimeout(wire, 150);

        // Continuous monitoring for Streamlit rerenders
        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => { wire(); });
        observer.observe(parentDoc.body, {childList: true, subtree: true});
    })();
    </script>
    </div>
    " scrolling="no" sandbox="allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox allow-same-origin allow-scripts allow-downloads" title="st.iframe">
